errorCodes.meaning: The community has events turned off (VTI-EVT-007). Nothing was changed.
The event is already published or is cancelled.
The event's time has already passed.
The community's `events` policy refused publication (VTI-EVT-080). Its reason is in `details.reason`. The event stays a draft.

AccessDetails.description: Where the event happens and how to join it (VTI-EVT-060 – 063). Answered by vtc/events/access/show to a registrant who is going, from `revealAt` if set; included in the event itself only where `public` is true.

notes.description: Anything else attendees need. Plain text.

public.description: Show the access details with the event to its whole audience. Absent means false.

revealAt.description: Not before this, even to a registrant who is going. Absent means on acceptance.

AccessDetails.title: AccessDetails

Accessibility.description: What the event offers for access, as the host states it (VTI-EVT-036). Each flag absent means not stated, not that it is missing.
Accessibility.title: Accessibility

CalendarId.description: Opaque identifier of a calendar: `cal_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-010).
CalendarId.title: CalendarId

CodeOfConduct.description: A code of conduct a registrant acknowledges before the registration is accepted (VTI-EVT-035). `sha256` pins the text acknowledged.
CodeOfConduct.title: CodeOfConduct

Count.description: A number of registrants as shown to someone who is not a host: `exact` at or above the event's count threshold, `fewerThan` (the threshold) below it, so a small count does not single anyone out (VTI-EVT-054). Exactly one of the two.
Count.title: Count

DynamicRule.description: A dynamic group's membership rule: a member belongs when every condition holds and they have not opted out. The community evaluates it under its `groups` policy and recomputes membership whenever a fact it reads changes, always excluding opted-out entries.
DynamicRule.title: DynamicRule

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Event.description: An event as the caller may see it. Members a caller may not see are left out: `registration` settings' `questions` are shown to everyone who may register, `access` only where it is public, `goingCount` as the roster setting allows (VTI-EVT-054).

access.description: Only where the access details are public, or the caller is a host.

cancelReason.description: Present once cancelled, where the host gave one. Plain text.

countThreshold.description: Below this many going, a count is shown as `fewerThan`. Absent means 5.

full.description: True when `capacity` is reached. Shown to everyone who may register, whatever `showCount` says, since a registrant learns it anyway.

goingCount.description: People going, plus-ones included: exact for a host; for anyone else only where `showCount` is true, and then as `Count` states.

hosts.description: The event's appointed hosts. Its creator is the first.

listed.description: Listed to its whole audience. An unlisted event is answered by vtc/events/show to a member of its audience who names it, and left out of vtc/events/list (VTI-EVT-022).

sequence.description: Incremented on every change of `when`, `access`, `status` or `kind` after publication — the changes a registrant must notice, as iTIP's SEQUENCE (VTI-EVT-006).

showCount.description: Show the number going to the audience, subject to `countThreshold`. Absent means false.

suggestedReminderMinutes.description: Reminders the hosts suggest, as minutes before the start. A member's agent applies them unless the member chose otherwise; the community sends no reminder itself (VTI-EVT-040).

Event.title: Event

EventAudience.description: Who may see and register for the event (VTI-EVT-020). A member is in the audience when `scope` admits them and, where `rule` is present, the rule does too. The audience is checked when a member reads or registers, never taken from a notification (VTI-EVT-021). The hosts are always admitted.

rule.description: Optional: a further test over verified facts, in the dynamic-group rule language. Count facts (`kudosReceived`, `ideasSelected`, `electionTickets`) are refused here as a non-badge group refuses them.

EventAudience.title: EventAudience

EventAudienceScope.description: Whom the event is for, before `rule` narrows it. `members`: every active member. `groups`: members of any of `groups` — which covers a badge, since a community badge is a group. `roles`: members holding any of `roles`.
EventAudienceScope.title: EventAudienceScope

EventDescription.description: What the event or calendar is. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
EventDescription.title: EventDescription

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

EventInstant.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC, whole seconds, such as `2026-11-30T18:30:00Z`.
EventInstant.title: EventInstant

EventKind.description: `event`: anything that happens at a time — a meetup, a workshop, a social. `meeting`: an event that may also carry an agenda, a chair, a quorum, minutes and motions; tasks that only mean something for a meeting refuse an event. Fixed for the event's life (VTI-EVT-003).
EventKind.title: EventKind

EventLifecycle.description: `draft`: seen only by its hosts, changes freely, takes no registrations. `published`: seen by its audience, takes registrations; its roster setting is fixed. `cancelled`: will not happen; kept so registrants and their agents see it was cancelled, and takes no registrations. Whether a published event has ended is read from its time, never stored (VTI-EVT-004).
EventLifecycle.title: EventLifecycle

EventTitle.description: A short name. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
EventTitle.title: EventTitle

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

FieldKey.description: Identifier of a directory field. A key with no `.` is a BASE field, the same in every community: `displayName`, `nickname`, `avatar`, `pronouns`, `bio`, `links` (written by the member) and `role`, `joinedAt`, `did`, `personhood` (derived from the community's own records, never stored on a card). A community-defined field MUST use a reverse-DNS key (`org.example.employer`), so a base key never collides with one, and a key is never reused with a different meaning once defined.
FieldKey.title: FieldKey

GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.
GroupId.title: GroupId

JSCalendarDuration.description: A non-negative duration in the subset of ISO 8601 JSCalendar uses: `P` then weeks or days, then `T` with hours, minutes and seconds, such as `PT1H30M`, `P1D` or `P2W`. No months or years. Used only for `When.duration`, which carries JSCalendar's own member and encoding verbatim; this family's own offsets are integers naming their unit (`ReminderMinutes`).
JSCalendarDuration.title: JSCalendarDuration

LocalDateTime.description: A local date and time with no offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, as JSCalendar's LocalDateTime. Read in the event's `timeZone`.
LocalDateTime.title: LocalDateTime

Place.description: A physical location, as JSCalendar's Location.

description.description: Directions, a door code. Plain text.

Place.title: Place

PlaceSummary.description: A coarse hint shown with the event to its whole audience — `Central London`, `Online` — never the address. Plain text.
PlaceSummary.title: PlaceSummary

RegistrationMode.description: `open`: a member of the audience who registers is going at once (or waitlisted when full). `approval`: a registration is pending until a host decides it. `closed`: no registrations; the event is for information only (VTI-EVT-031).
RegistrationMode.title: RegistrationMode

RegistrationQuestion.description: A question a registrant answers when registering. Answers are read by the event's hosts only, and are deleted on the event's retention schedule (VTI-EVT-034, VTI-EVT-090).

label.description: The question as shown. Plain text.

required.description: The registration is refused without an answer. Absent means false.

RegistrationQuestion.title: RegistrationQuestion

RegistrationQuestionId.description: A question's key within its event.
RegistrationQuestionId.title: RegistrationQuestionId

RegistrationQuestionKind.description: `text`: a free answer of at most 500 characters. `choice`: one of `choices`. `boolean`: yes or no.
RegistrationQuestionKind.title: RegistrationQuestionKind

capacity.description: The most people who may be going, plus-ones included. Absent means no limit.

closesAt.description: Registrations and changes are refused after this, except withdrawal (VTI-EVT-037). Absent means at the event's start.

opensAt.description: Registrations are refused before this. Absent means from publication.

plusOnes.description: The most guests a registrant may bring. Absent means 0.

waitlist.description: Registrations beyond `capacity` are waitlisted, and the first on the waitlist becomes going when a place frees (VTI-EVT-033). Absent means false: a registration beyond capacity is refused.

ReminderMinutes.description: A reminder's offset: how many minutes before the event's start it is due. At most four weeks.
ReminderMinutes.title: ReminderMinutes

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/publish/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/publish/0.1#response.

event.description: The published event, as its host sees it.

Response.title: VTC Events — Publish — response payload

RoleName.description: A role identifier: lowercase, hyphen-separated, at most 64 characters. Compared by exact string equality. It is the value an AclEntry 0.2 carries in `role`.
RoleName.title: RoleName

RosterSetting.description: Who may see who is registered (VTI-EVT-050). `visible`: registrants who are going or maybe see each other. `hidden`: no registrant sees another; the event's hosts do. Fixed once the event is published (VTI-EVT-051) and recorded on each registration (VTI-EVT-052).
RosterSetting.title: RosterSetting

RuleCondition.description: One test over a verified fact about a member. `fact: role` tests the member's community role; `fact: field` tests an `admin`- or `credential`-sourced directory field named by `field`; `fact: personhood` tests whether a personhood assertion is on file; `fact: joinedAt` tests when they joined. A rule never reads a self-asserted (`member`-sourced) field: a member must not be able to join a group by editing their card. `kudosReceived`, `ideasSelected` and `electionTickets` are counts the community keeps of its own records (kudos the member accepted, ideas of theirs a board selected, elections it issued them a ticket in), compared with `atLeast`; only a badge's group reads them (VTI-BDG-015), and any other group refuses them with `ruleInvalid`.

count.description: With `atLeast`: the least a count fact (`kudosReceived`, `ideasSelected`, `electionTickets`) must be. Present exactly when `op` is `atLeast`.

op.description: `equals` compares with `value`; `oneOf` with any of `values`; `exists` needs neither; `before` and `after` compare a date fact with `value`; `atLeast` compares a count fact with `count`.

RuleCondition.title: RuleCondition

TimeZoneId.description: An IANA time zone name, such as `Europe/London`, or `Etc/UTC`. A responder MUST refuse a name its time zone database does not know.
TimeZoneId.title: TimeZoneId

VirtualFeature.description: What a virtual location offers, as JSCalendar's VirtualLocation `features`.
VirtualFeature.title: VirtualFeature

VirtualPlace.description: A way to join online, as JSCalendar's VirtualLocation.

description.description: A passcode, dial-in numbers. Plain text.

uri.description: How to join: an `https` link, or a `tel`, `sip` or `sips` URI for a dial-in. No other scheme.
